QRMForge — third-party software

QRMForge project code: Copyright (c) 2026 Alessandro Lucaferro.
License: GPL-3.0-only. https://github.com/logocomune/qrmforge

JUCE — Raw Material Software Ltd and contributors
Desktop interface, graphics and DSP support. GPLv3 option for the configured
JUCE 7 distribution; individual modules retain their own notices.
https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE/tree/7.0.5

PipeWire — PipeWire contributors
Audio routing and processing integration. MIT/Expat core; individual modules
and dependencies retain their respective licenses. Version depends on build host.
https://pipewire.org/

RNNoise 0.2 — Xiph.Org and contributors
Speech noise reduction and bundled model. BSD-style license; see COPYING.
https://github.com/xiph/rnnoise

SpeexDSP — Xiph.Org and contributors
Speech preprocessing. BSD-style license. Version depends on build host.
https://github.com/xiph/speexdsp

DeepFilterNet 0.5.6 — Hendrik Schroeter and contributors
Speech enhancement backend and official model. MIT option selected from the
upstream MIT OR Apache-2.0 grant. See LICENSE-MIT.
Conservative dependency inventory and retained crate/Rust notices:
deepfilter/INVENTORY.json and deepfilter/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt.
https://github.com/Rikorose/DeepFilterNet/tree/v0.5.6

LADSPA interface header — Richard W. E. Furse, Paul Barton-Davis and contributors
Private DeepFilterNet ABI interface. LGPL-2.1-or-later.
See the header notices and LADSPA-LGPL-2.1.
https://www.ladspa.org/

WavPack — David Bryant and contributors
Lossless recording. BSD-style license. Version depends on build host.
https://github.com/dbry/WavPack

Portable packages also include desktop, font, compression and support libraries,
plus the AppImage runtime when wrapped. Their available distribution copyright
notices, versions and common license texts are included under usr/share/licenses.
This credits list does not replace the original notices below or the applicable
source-distribution requirements. Build tools are not necessarily shipped in
QRMForge. DeepFilterNet crate notices are retained conservatively, including
optional/build/non-Linux dependencies; the inventory records evidence and limits.
Exact binary composition and the AppImage runtime require separate verification;
this list is not a complete binary SBOM.
